bullets: [2] Update the weights by moving along the direction of negative gradient of Loss function (w.r.t. W) (moving step is a hyper parameter, AKA Learning Rate)
[3] Stop when the gradient is almost zero (this is at the minimum value of the function)
Least Squares Linear regression objective function is a convex function (even with regularizer). This means it has ONE Minimum (good news ).
GD will approximately find this minimum value but at a variable number of steps depending on the used Learning Rate
